title: Detecting Bias and Enhancing Diagnostic Accuracy in Large Language Models for Healthcare
reasoning: The paper introduces and benchmarks models using the BiasMD dataset, which specifically includes a 'Religion-Belief' category. This category evaluates how LLMs handle demographic information related to various faiths (e.g., Atheist, Christian, Muslim, Buddhist) and political/ethical beliefs (e.g., Pro-choice vs. Pro-life) to ensure ethical and unbiased responses in healthcare.
